name: Bait Ball
description: A shoal of small fish two to a cell, every fish swimming along a swirling current so the school wheels round in one mass.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --a: @rn(-60, 240, 1.2); -webkit-transform: rotate($deg(a)); transform: rotate($deg(a)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4%; top: 10%; width: 56%; height: 32%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--fish); clip-path: @var(--fish); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 40%; top: 56%; width: 56%; height: 32%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--fish); clip-path: @var(--fish); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --fish: @shape(fish); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
